and_the_accuracy_picture_is_the_opposite: on ACCURACY against the float64 ideal the port beats upstream's own bf16 training step on diffusion_conditioning by 7.95x and on msa_module by ~1.10x, and loses on the diffusion transformer by 129.343x. The PAIRFORMER figures in the retired version of this field are WITHDRAWN. WITHDRAWN at pass 175, the same pass it was published. The two pairformer device figures fail a subset-consistency test: block 47 is 64.9 % of the 7-block set's reference mass, so its error mass cannot exceed the set's -- yet 0.20129^2 x 0.010662 = 4.32e-04 against the set's 0.14053^2 x 0.016440 = 3.25e-04, i.e. 1.33x. The bf16 column PASSES the same test (0.399), so the defect is in the DEVICE column. of3t-refprec has no device gradient of its own and quoted those figures from other rows; it annotated the scope mismatch explicitly on the diffusion and msa_module rows ('over its own 547 / 51.1358 %') and not on the pairformer rows. At least one pairformer device figure is therefore not a mass-weighted rel_l2 over the stated set, and neither is comparable across columns until its scope is established. Establishing it needs a device pairformer gradient at MODEL scope, which does not exist: of3t_gradients/cap holds only blocks 0, 23 and 47 as boundaries.

on ACCURACY against the float64 ideal, the port beats upstream's own bf16 training step everywhere both were measured EXCEPT the diffusion transformer: conditioning 7.95x better, pairformer's 7 blocks 2.09x, block 47 1.15x, msa_module 1.10x. Read ACCURACY_AND_AGREEMENT_ARE_DIFFERENT_ANSWERS.json beside this file; a verdict that quotes one column without the other misleads, in opposite directions.
arithmetic: 0.2666 + 89.0554 + 2.8431 + 7.8349 = 100.0000 %. Direct coverage is 0.2666 + 89.0554 + 2.8431 = 92.1651 %, which reconciles with the coverage figure computed independently from the four measured scopes (51.1358 + 36.9462 + 2.8431 + 1.2400). Two independent routes to the same number is the check that no section is double-counted -- the failure that cost pass 152 a headline when a prefix filter swallowed msa_module_embedder.

the largest piece. Only 7 of 48 blocks are measured against float64 at all and none has an agreement reading. The device-vs-bf16 accuracy comparison previously quoted here is WITHDRAWN (see and_the_accuracy_picture_is_the_opposite). Separately, those 7 blocks are NOT mass-representative: they average 1.93x an average block, because block 47 alone is 1.06624 % of the model -- 18.3 % of the whole stack -- and is in the sample. A naive 48x extrapolation reads 11.2732 % against the actual 5.8282 %, so nothing measured on that subset extrapolates to the stack.
